title: Nord Stream sabotage and hybrid war on Europe
summary: Anders Puck Nielsen analyzes the Nord Stream pipeline sabotage using Kilcullen's theory of liminal warfare and prospect theory. He argues from the operational design that Russia is the most likely culprit, then discusses how hybrid warfare might be used against Europe.
why: HN points to it as a compact, reasoned case for Russian responsibility, though at least one commenter found the argument unconvincing.

quote.text: Anders Puck Nielsen has an under 15 minute video with a compelling explanation for why Russia is most likely to have done it
